notes: Three bases: total sample (p. 3), expressed votes (p. 4), and expressed votes of respondents who say they will vote (p. 5, other_subset). Crosstabs by round-1 vote (pp. 6-8) are not recorded. The report names no population beyond 'reprezentativ pe variabilele socio-demografice'. The report names no client either: the sponsor comes from HotNews (verifield-doc-002, https://hotnews.ro/live-video-sondajul-prezentat-de-nicusor-dan-la-trei-zile-dupa-primul-tur-al-alegerilor-prezidentiale-1967952), whose headline says the poll was 'realizat de Verifield la comanda lui' (Nicușor Dan), who presented it on 2025-05-07 (owner decision 2026-11-27: a client stated by a media outlet is recorded as the sponsor, with its source in notes). HotNews gives the margin of error as +/-3%; the report's 3.19 is used (pollster's report wins).
